| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Country | Colombia |
| Official name of visa | Visa V – Nómadas Digitales |
| Legal basis | Resolución 5477 de 2022 |
| Target group | foreign professionals, remote workers, freelancers who do not seek local employment |
| Duration of stay | up to two years (maximum) |
| Monthly income requirement | at least three times Colombia’s minimum monthly wage (SMMLV) – roughly **$1,100–$1,400 USD** per month (as of 2026) |
| Incomes must be earned from abroad; local employment not allowed |
| Minimum monthly income must be met **every month** (no averaging) |
| Application fee | around **$54 USD** (visa study fee) |
| Issuance fee | between **$170–$230 USD** (depends on exchange rate) |
| Health insurance requirement | health insurance with explicit medical repatriation coverage for entire stay |
| Proof required | remote‑work contracts or letters, passport, passport‑style photo, proof of relationship for dependents |
| Renewal | possible; must re‑apply with updated proof of income, health insurance, remote‑work status |
| Processing time | typically 1–3 weeks, up to 30 calendar days |
| Exempt passport nations | United States, Germany, Australia, Canada, Spain, Indonesia, Portugal (among others) |
| Eligibility criteria | 1 – remote workers/freelancers 2 – entrepreneurs with digital‑focused businesses not planning local employment |
| Restrictions | cannot take local employment or provide services to Colombian clients; visa cancelled if absent > 6 consecutive months |
| Certificate of registration | if visa > 3 months, must register with Migración Colombia and obtain a Cédula de Extranjería within 15 days of arrival |
| Tax residence threshold | 183 days in a 12‑month period triggers Colombian tax residency |
| Mention of Spanish language | the article title includes “Nómadas Digitales”, but the page does not explicitly state Spanish is the main language spoken in Colombia (only the official language is implied) |
| Pacific coastline | mentioned indirectly via mention of “coastal towns like Cartagena” but no explicit statement about Pacific coastline or other major bodies of water |
| Same‑sex marriage recognition | not mentioned |
| Herbalife availability | not mentioned |

The evidence is **fully exhaustive for the visa topic** but does **not** provide any information on the additional criteria required by the overall question (language, coastline, marriage recognition, product availability).

- Confirmation that Spain is the main language in a given country.
